newsitem.title: USA: CyberGuard sees Q4 revenues in line.
newsitem.headline: CyberGuard sees Q4 revenues in line.

text.p: CyberGuard Corp said Wednesday that its fourth quarter revenue results will be in line with analysts' expectations.

This company said the results represent record quarterly revenue results for CyberGuard Firewall products, and continued revenue growth at an annualized rate greater than recent market research data projections for the firewall industry.
Final earnings results for the quarter and the 1997 fiscal year are scheduled to be released the first week of September.
CyberGuard did not say what analysts' expectations for revenue were, and could not be reached immediately for comment.
CyberGuard is a provider of network security and electronic commerce solutions.
